legal.title: Legal
legal.draftNote: MVP legal pack · RU/EN · launch geo: RU/CIS. Lawyer review required before a new market.
legal.ageBody: This site is for adults 18+ only. Content is informational and is not an offer to gamble or gambling advertising where that is restricted.
legal.ageGeoBody: Launch languages are Russian and English. Content targets RU/CIS audiences. If gambling is illegal or restricted where you live, do not use affiliate links or register with operators.
legal.responsibleBody: Gambling should stay entertainment. SS Audit supports responsible-gambling principles and never promises winnings.
legal.responsibleSigns1: Playing with money you cannot afford to lose
legal.responsibleSigns4: Using gambling to fix money problems
legal.responsibleHelp1: Set deposit and time limits in the casino settings
legal.privacyBody: This Policy explains how SS Audit processes personal and technical data. SS Audit is an informational portal about online casinos: we do not accept bets and do not provide gambling services.
legal.privacyWhoBody: The SS Audit site operator processes data as needed to run the portal, moderation, support and security. For privacy requests email privacy [at] ss-audit.local.
legal.privacyData1: Account data: email, name/nickname, hashed password, role (user, partner, staff).
legal.privacyData2: Content you submit: casino reviews, forum posts, support messages and B2B requests.
legal.privacyData3: Technical data: IP address, user-agent, UI language, theme, session and cookie-consent identifiers.
legal.privacyData4: Reward payout details (when the review rewards program is enabled): wallet/payment details you provide to receive a reward.
legal.privacyGoals: We use data to: create and maintain accounts; publish and moderate reviews and the forum; answer requests; prevent spam, abuse and fraud; run reward payouts when applicable; keep the service secure and reliable.
legal.privacyLegalBody: Processing is based on your consent (registration, publishing content, optional cookies), performance of the user terms, and the operator’s legitimate interest in security and moderation. Where a launch geo requires different bases, we will update this Policy before go-live there.
legal.privacyStorageBody: Data is stored on the platform operator’s servers and with infrastructure providers (hosting, email, CDN) as needed to run the service. Crypto/payment providers only receive payout details required for a reward you requested. We do not sell personal data or share it for third-party marketing.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You may request access, correction, export or deletion of your account and related data (except records we must keep by law or for disputes/security). We reply to the email used in the request within a reasonable time.
legal.privacyDelete: Privacy and deletion requests: privacy [at] ss-audit.local. Subject: “Privacy request”.
legal.privacyChildrenBody: The site is for adults 18+ only. We do not knowingly collect children’s data. If you learn of an underage registration, contact privacy [at] ss-audit.local.
legal.cookiesBody: This Cookie Policy explains which cookies and similar technologies SS Audit uses, why, and how you can manage consent.
legal.cookiesWhatBody: Cookies are small pieces of data stored by the site in your browser. We may also use localStorage for some preferences (for example theme and cookie consent) when the browser allows it.
legal.cookiesNecessary: Required for core site functions and do not need extra consent beyond using the service: UI language (xr_lang / i18n), theme, age-gate confirmation, cookie-consent choice, user or staff login session, and session security/antifraud.
legal.cookiesOptional: May include visit metrics and technical quality counters. On the current MVP, analytics may be off. If enabled, only after you accept in the cookie banner. You can refuse with “Necessary only” or by clearing consent and reloading the page.
legal.cookiesManageBody: You can delete site cookies in browser settings, use a private window, or withdraw consent by clearing SS Audit consent storage and refreshing — the banner will show again. Blocking necessary cookies may break login, language or theme persistence.
legal.cookiesThirdBody: Affiliate clicks to casinos go via /go/. Operator sites have their own cookie and privacy policies — we do not control them. Any future embeds will be listed here before they are enabled.
legal.affiliateBody: SS Audit includes affiliate links to casinos. Clicks via /go/ may earn us a commission. This does not affect editorial scores or review moderation. HOT is paid placement and is always labelled.
